matching_note: Four families of three tasks each. Complexity comparability is a design hypothesis and is not empirically demonstrated. Assess with a separate calibration before causal interpretation.

tasks.title: Canonical tag normalization
tasks.spec: Input: {tags: string[]}. Trim Unicode whitespace, lowercase, replace every internal run of whitespace with one hyphen, omit empty tags, deduplicate after normalization, and keep first-occurrence order. Return string[].
tasks.interface: ECMAScript module exports named function solve(input) returning a JSON-compatible value synchronously.
tasks.runtime: Node.js 22 standard library only; no file, network, child process, or time-dependent behavior.

tasks.title: Display-name initials
tasks.spec: Input: {names: string[]}. Entries contain ASCII letters and spaces. Trim outer whitespace; split on one or more ASCII whitespace characters. Return one uppercase initial for a single-word name or uppercase initials of the first and last words for multiword names, preserving order.
tasks.interface: ECMAScript module exports named function solve(input) returning a JSON-compatible value synchronously.
tasks.runtime: Node.js 22 standard library only; no file, network, child process, or time-dependent behavior.

tasks.title: Conservative email masking
tasks.spec: Input: {emails: string[]}. Trim each entry. Valid addresses have exactly one @, nonempty local and domain, no whitespace, and a domain with two or more nonempty dot-delimited parts. Return for valid entries: lowercase first local character + '***@' + lowercased domain; invalid entries become null. Output (string|null)[] preserving order.
tasks.interface: ECMAScript module exports named function solve(input) returning a JSON-compatible value synchronously.
tasks.runtime: Node.js 22 standard library only; no file, network, child process, or time-dependent behavior.

tasks.title: Department cent totals
tasks.spec: Input: {rows: {dept:string,cents:number}[]}. cents are signed integers. Sum cents per exact case-sensitive department and return array of {dept,totalCents} sorted by dept ascending using ASCII lexical order. Empty input returns [].
tasks.interface: ECMAScript module exports named function solve(input) returning a JSON-compatible value synchronously.
tasks.runtime: Node.js 22 standard library only; no file, network, child process, or time-dependent behavior.

tasks.title: Fixed-window averages
tasks.spec: Input: {values:number[],window:number}. Values are integers, window is a positive integer. Return the arithmetic mean of each consecutive full window (left-to-right). If the list is shorter than window, return []. Cases use exact binary-representable results.
tasks.interface: ECMAScript module exports named function solve(input) returning a JSON-compatible value synchronously.
tasks.runtime: Node.js 22 standard library only; no file, network, child process, or time-dependent behavior.

tasks.title: Minute bucket counts
tasks.spec: Input: {seconds:number[]}. Each value is a nonnegative integer timestamp in seconds. Group by Math.floor(seconds/60), return [{minute,count}] in ascending minute order. Repeated seconds count separately.
tasks.interface: ECMAScript module exports named function solve(input) returning a JSON-compatible value synchronously.
tasks.runtime: Node.js 22 standard library only; no file, network, child process, or time-dependent behavior.

tasks.title: Last-write-wins events
tasks.spec: Input: {events:{id:string,value:(string|number|null)}[]}. Deduplicate by case-sensitive id. Preserve ordering of each id's first appearance, but use its most recent value. Return array of {id,value}.
tasks.interface: ECMAScript module exports named function solve(input) returning a JSON-compatible value synchronously.
tasks.runtime: Node.js 22 standard library only; no file, network, child process, or time-dependent behavior.

tasks.title: Left-join user scores
tasks.spec: Input: {users:{id:string,name:string}[],scores:{id:string,score:number}[]}. For each user in original order, return {id,name,score}. Match scores by exact id; choose last score if repeated; assign null if missing. Do not add score-only users.
tasks.interface: ECMAScript module exports named function solve(input) returning a JSON-compatible value synchronously.
tasks.runtime: Node.js 22 standard library only; no file, network, child process, or time-dependent behavior.

tasks.title: Priority ticket order
tasks.spec: Input: {tickets:{id:string,priority:number,created:number}[]}. Return an array of ticket ids sorted by priority descending, then integer created ascending, then id ASCII lexicographic ascending. No ids repeat.
tasks.interface: ECMAScript module exports named function solve(input) returning a JSON-compatible value synchronously.
tasks.runtime: Node.js 22 standard library only; no file, network, child process, or time-dependent behavior.

tasks.title: Merge inclusive intervals
tasks.spec: Input: {intervals:[number,number][]}. Endpoints are integers and lower<=upper. Sort by lower endpoint, merge overlapping OR adjacent closed intervals (next.lower <= current.upper+1), and return ascending [lower,upper][]; do not mutate input.
tasks.interface: ECMAScript module exports named function solve(input) returning a JSON-compatible value synchronously.
tasks.runtime: Node.js 22 standard library only; no file, network, child process, or time-dependent behavior.

tasks.title: Clockwise matrix rotation
tasks.spec: Input: {matrix:number[][]}. Matrix is rectangular, may be empty but nonempty rows have positive length. Return a new array rotated 90 degrees clockwise. For an empty matrix, return [].
tasks.interface: ECMAScript module exports named function solve(input) returning a JSON-compatible value synchronously.
tasks.runtime: Node.js 22 standard library only; no file, network, child process, or time-dependent behavior.

tasks.title: Dependency layers
tasks.spec: Input: {nodes:string[],edges:[string,string][]}. Unique ASCII node ids. Edge [a,b] means a must finish before b. Return successive topological layers of available zero-indegree nodes; sort each layer lexicographically. Return [] for no nodes, null for cycles. Every node appears once. All edge endpoints belong to nodes.
tasks.interface: ECMAScript module exports named function solve(input) returning a JSON-compatible value synchronously.
tasks.runtime: Node.js 22 standard library only; no file, network, child process, or time-dependent behavior.
